１１９番の正しいかけ方 | 広報素材 | 総務省消防庁

notes: Emergency calls about incidents and accidents go to the police on 110; for non-urgent consultations use the nearest police station. Source: https://www.npa.go.jp/goiken_index.html (National Police Agency), retrieved 2026-09-26.

119 is the number for both fire and ambulance: the 119 dispatcher first asks whether it is a fire or a medical emergency. Source: https://www.fdma.go.jp/publication/portal/items/portal001_pamphiet_english.pdf (Fire and Disaster Management Agency, Guide for Ambulance Services, English), retrieved 2026-09-26.
